description:
We are a group of 5 people participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge with the project "Abandoned but not forgotten".

Our goal is to shine a light on the landers, rovers and probes humanity has left behind on the Moon and Mars - machines that once carried our curiosity to other worlds and now rest silently as part of their landscape. Through this project, we want to honor abandoned explorers  while inspiring next generation of scientist to turning today's fairy tail into tommorow's reality.
